title: Jason Pearson
description: "I chose to depict a key moment in the relationship between Han and Chewie," explains Jason Pearson. "Han rescues the Wookiee from enslavement and then burns his Imperial 'draft card' It's a scene that isn't shown in any of the movies, of course, but it is part of the back story of STAR WARS. Pearson began his comics career in 1990 with a LEGION OF SUPER-HEROES job at DC. This was followed with THE UNCANNY X-MEN ANNUAL and the current SAVAGE DRAGON mini-series for Eric Larsen. "Never second guess the fans" is Pearson's advice to publishers and creators. "Go with your instincts. Tell the best story you can, and remember: a single panel isn't all that you look at. It's the whole job— the whole story that's important."
